title: A Safety-Gated Multimodal AI Backend for Mental-Health Support: Hierarchical State Representation, Conservative Risk Fusion, and Controlled Generation in Anian
abstract: arXiv:2608.26162v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safety-critical mental-health support systems must distinguish when supportive conversation is appropriate from when free-form generation should be blocked. This paper presents Anian, a safety-gated multimodal AI backend for perinatal mental-health support and mindfulness-intervention routing. Anian is not intended to diagnose psychiatric conditions or replace clinical care or crisis intervention. Its modular pipeline places generative AI downstream of structured state representation, conservative risk fusion, and response gating. User text or voice-derived ASR transcripts are mapped into four linked layers: L1 emotion states, L2 psychosocial constructs, L3 safety risk, and L4 intervention routes. Local text- and rule-based safety evidence is fused with external voice-derived evidence using a highest-risk-priority rule, S_fusion = max(S_local, S_external). translated_title: 面向心理健康支持的安全门控多模态AI后端：层次化状态表示、保守风险融合与受控生成在Anian中的应用
translated_abstract: 安全关键的心理健康支持系统必须区分何时适宜进行支持性对话，以及何时应阻止自由形式的生成。本文介绍了Anian，一个用于围产期心理健康支持和正念干预路由的安全门控多模态AI后端。Anian并非旨在诊断精神疾病或替代临床护理或危机干预。其模块化管道将生成式AI置于结构化状态表示、保守风险融合和响应门控之后。用户文本或语音衍生的ASR转录被映射到四个关联层：L1情绪状态、L2心理社会构念、L3安全风险和L4干预路由。局部基于文本和规则的证据与外部语音衍生证据通过最高风险优先规则融合，即S_fusion = max(S_local, S_external)。在中度或高度融合风险下，普通AI生成的响应和文本转语音功能将被阻止。
tldr: Anian通过安全门控机制，在生成式AI前融合多模态风险证据并优先处理高风险，从而确保心理健康支持对话的安全性和干预路由的可靠性。
en_tdlr: Anian ensures safe mental-health support by gating generative AI behind hierarchical state representation and conservative risk fusion that prioritizes high-risk evidence.
